## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `./gradlew clean test lint assembleDebug bundleRelease --no-daemon`
- [ ] Tested on a connected Android device when the change affects the service or UI
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, keystores, tokens, or private user data are included

## Accessibility detector checklist

- [ ] Search itself is not blocked
- [ ] Direct and media shared by friends remain usable
- [ ] Normal posts are not blocked
- [ ] Reels in the feed/Reels viewer still block as intended
